description: This file defines a Orleans grain class 'ChainedGrain' along with its state class 'ChainedGrainState'. It includes methods for setting and getting the next grain in a chain, calculating values recursively, and validating state. The file is part of unit tests for Orleans grains, specifically for a chained grain pattern.

classes.name: ChainedGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a chained grain, including Id, X, and a reference to the next grain.

classes.name: ChainedGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IChainedGrain, supporting chaining, value calculation, and validation functionalities.

methods.name: ChainedGrain(ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger for the grain.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Returns the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns the Id of the grain.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Returns the X value of the grain.

methods.name: GetCalculatedValue
methods.description: Recursively calculates the sum of X values along the chain.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: SetNextNested
methods.description: Sets the next grain using a nested holder.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the state of the chain, ensuring the next grain is set or null as expected.

methods.name: PassThis
methods.description: Passes this grain to the next in the chain.

methods.name: PassNull
methods.description: Passes null to the next in the chain.

methods.name: PassThisNested
methods.description: Passes this grain nested within a holder to the next.

methods.name: PassNullNested
methods.description: Passes null nested within a holder to the next.
